• App version and operating system

Data is sent via Discord Webhook for easy monitoring.

Tut.1_Desc: Welcome to RagnaBộ điều khiển! This tutorial will help you get started.
Tut_2_Desc: Tired of missing tiny items? When you open your inventory, use the D-Điều khiển to snap the cursor perfectly from slot to slot. Nhấn 'A' to double-click and equip items instantly.
Tut_3_Desc: Casting Storm Gust has never been easier. Giữ down your skill button (e.g., L1+A). The targeting circle appears. Aim with the right stick. Simply RELEASE the button to cast the spell!
Tut_4_Desc: Having trouble clicking on a fast-moving Poring? Just tilt the Phải Joystick slightly towards the monster and click R3. The engine will fire a micro-spiral click, guaranteeing a hit on the hitbox.
Tut_4_Title: Giúp đỡ một cách khôn ngoan
Tut_5_Desc: Need complex combos? Ghi your key presses, then open the Visual Timeline Chỉnh sửaor. You can drag and drop the delays perfectly to match the server's lag and your character's ASPD.
